## Pull Request Checklist

Please ensure the following before submitting your pull request:

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's code style and formatting standards.
- [ ] No emojis are included in commit messages, PR descriptions, or source code comments.
- [ ] Documentation is updated in both **English (`README.md`)** and **Spanish (`README.es.md`)**.
- [ ] Netcode compatibility with version 38 is preserved without breaking changes.
- [ ] All relevant tests pass locally.
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, or retail map files are committed.
